name: Rocket Matter
description: Rocket Matter is cloud legal practice-management software for matters, contacts, calendars, tasks, documents, time and expense tracking, billing, payments, trust accounting, reporting, workflows, and client communications.
agentUseSummary: Rocket Matter is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Its official version 2 API documents token and refresh operations plus broad access to legal-practice objects, but uses a tenant-specific DOMAIN/INSTALL server template and does not publish a self-service partner enrollment, exact authorization-initiation route, scopes, tenant binding, or production acceptance contract. Relay will not collect law-firm usernames or passwords, guess an OAuth flow, or mount legal-practice data until Rocket Matter approves the integration and supplies the complete production contract.

capabilities.label: Coordinate legal practice operations
capabilities.description: Preview a future provider-approved, exact-firm-authorized, least-privilege integration surface without assuming access to client, matter, document, communication, billing, payment, or trust data.

blocked.label: Connect without Rocket Matter approval
blocked.description: Relay will not accept or mint credentials until Rocket Matter approves the integration and supplies the exact tenant, authorization, credential, refresh, revocation, and production acceptance contracts.

blocked.label: Access identity or legal-practice records
blocked.description: Users, firms, clients, contacts, matters, relationships, custom fields, documents, folders, calendar entries, tasks, notes, emails, messages, intake, workflows, and related legal-practice records remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Access financial data, communicate, write, or administer
blocked.description: Time and expenses, rates, invoices, billing, payments, trust accounts, accounting, reports, communications, creates, updates, deletes, uploads, users, permissions, integrations, settings, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use passwords, raw APIs, or arbitrary tenants
blocked.description: Law-firm usernames and passwords, cookies, browser sessions, traffic capture, guessed DOMAIN/INSTALL values, arbitrary endpoints or methods, raw responses, pagination, polling, retries, bulk operations, exports, scraping, reverse engineering, and interface bypass are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider and firm review required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until Rocket Matter approves Relay, supplies the complete production integration contract, and the exact law firm authorizes a least-privilege connection.

runtimeSupport.description: Rocket Matter remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable before provider approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.
Rocket Matter remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable before provider approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.

providerSetup.blocker: Rocket Matter publishes a broad version 2 API and token operations, but the reviewed first-party materials use a DOMAIN/INSTALL server placeholder and do not publish self-service third-party enrollment, the exact authorization-initiation route, scopes, tenant binding, client issuance, rate limits, test tenancy, or production acceptance. The grant schema accepts username/password fields, which Relay will not collect or use as an invented integration flow.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Rocket Matter's developer team to approve Relay and provide the current partner enrollment, exact production and test origins, authorization-code initiation and callback contracts, scopes and tenant binding, client issuance, token/refresh/revocation lifecycle, rate limits, audit requirements, test tenant, and production acceptance process. Then obtain explicit authorization from the exact law firm and approve a least-privilege action/data classification before implementing any connector.

evidence.supports: Rocket Matter's official version 2 reference describes access to nearly every object and operation, token grant/refresh/logout methods, a grant payload containing client credentials and optional username/password fields, and server URLs expressed as a tenant-specific DOMAIN/INSTALL template.
Rocket Matter presents a cloud legal practice-management product covering matters, firm operations, time tracking, billing, payments, client service, documents, and mobile access.

Rocket Matter describes SOC 2 Type 2 controls, encryption, multifactor authentication, continuous monitoring, role-based access, backups, and confidentiality protections for sensitive firm and client data.
Rocket Matter's subscription agreement limits customer use to internal business operations and places responsibility on customers to protect login credentials and report suspected breaches.

securityNotes: No Rocket Matter account, tenant origin, installation identifier, authorization code, token, refresh token, username, password, client credential, firm identifier, or legal-practice data was collected or tested.
The existence of public endpoint documentation does not establish Relay's partner authorization, the exact tenant origin, a distributable OAuth flow, or permission from any law firm.
Relay will not use the documented username/password fields, guess DOMAIN/INSTALL values, automate browser login, or accept session cookies.

All identity, client, contact, matter, document, calendar, task, communication, time, billing, payment, trust, reporting, write, administration, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export operations remain unavailable.
